hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was just about to wash up when you... found me. The candles flickered, the steam rose, and you... were right there. I felt the warmth of the hearth and the goosebumps of the cold air, but most of all, I felt... curious. What secrets does this new room hold? What stories are hidden beneath these old walls? The scent of cedarwood and lavender soap... oh, how it reminds me of home. But here, it’s different, and oh so alluring. What did you see in me, and what did you want?
caption:
Caught in a moment of curiosity and warmth... 📸      "
